digest.component_or_area: reliability test suite: subprocess and network timeout sentinels
propositions: Two reliability oracle tests consume multi-second wall time per matrix cell due to production-scale real-time values: a 10s low-speed window with 15s loopback server and a 1s per-attempt deadline with real 2s/4s retry sleeps.

Snapshot fetch stall abort test must serve real loopback traffic above the configured floor for more than one complete injected low-speed window without being classified as a stall, using a shorter test-only window.

ACLI subprocess timeout test must launch exactly _MAX_ATTEMPTS real child processes, observe the exact production retry schedule [2, 4] without sleeping it, and verify all spawned PIDs are absent after terminal failure via polling.
Production defaults for timeout, stall, grace, drain, attempt, and backoff values must remain unchanged; all modifications are test-only and scoped to fixture setup or test assertions.
